host.executionNote: Final-code original synthetic 25+3 regression, including permitted-set support; isolated fixture-only corpus.

corpus.databaseIsolation: Disposable PostgreSQL and legacy Elasticsearch; only the synthetic fixture is indexed.

entries.chunkKey: synthetic_knowledge.md#DeepResearch migration evaluation fixture > Ingest authorization#1
entries.title: synthetic_knowledge
entries.preview: DR-EVAL-01: Only an ADMIN may upload a knowledge-base document through the Java API.

entries.chunkKey: synthetic_knowledge.md#DeepResearch migration evaluation fixture > Upload checksum#2
entries.title: synthetic_knowledge
entries.preview: DR-EVAL-02: An unchanged content SHA-256 hash reuses the existing document version instead of triggering another parse.

entries.chunkKey: synthetic_knowledge.md#DeepResearch migration evaluation fixture > Parse state#3
entries.title: synthetic_knowledge
entries.preview: DR-EVAL-03: A remote document is ready for retrieval only after its parse state becomes DONE.

entries.chunkKey: synthetic_knowledge.md#DeepResearch migration evaluation fixture > Parse failure#4
entries.title: synthetic_knowledge
entries.preview: DR-EVAL-04: A failed remote parse is recorded as FAILED and the error must remain visible for reconciliation.

entries.chunkKey: synthetic_knowledge.md#DeepResearch migration evaluation fixture > Dataset permission#5
entries.title: synthetic_knowledge
entries.preview: DR-EVAL-05: The Java gateway sends only dataset IDs from its configured allowlist.

entries.chunkKey: synthetic_knowledge.md#DeepResearch migration evaluation fixture > Client secret#6
entries.title: synthetic_knowledge
entries.preview: DR-EVAL-06: The RAGFlow API key stays on the server and is never copied into browser responses.

entries.chunkKey: synthetic_knowledge.md#DeepResearch migration evaluation fixture > Evidence marker#7
entries.title: synthetic_knowledge
entries.preview: DR-EVAL-07: A displayed citation marker uses the format [来源N], where N starts at one for each response.

entries.chunkKey: synthetic_knowledge.md#DeepResearch migration evaluation fixture > Persistent source#8
entries.title: synthetic_knowledge
entries.preview: DR-EVAL-08: A stable RAGFlow citation begins with kb:ragflow: and includes dataset, document, and chunk IDs.

entries.chunkKey: synthetic_knowledge.md#DeepResearch migration evaluation fixture > Persistent source#8
entries.title: synthetic_knowledge
entries.preview: DR-EVAL-08: A stable RAGFlow citation begins with kb:ragflow: and includes dataset, document, and chunk IDs.

entries.chunkKey: synthetic_knowledge.md#DeepResearch migration evaluation fixture > Similarity score#9
entries.title: synthetic_knowledge
entries.preview: DR-EVAL-09: The normalized evidence score is the RAGFlow similarity value; it is not a legacy RRF score.

entries.chunkKey: synthetic_knowledge.md#DeepResearch migration evaluation fixture > Missing page#10
entries.title: synthetic_knowledge
entries.preview: DR-EVAL-10: If a parser does not provide a page number, the evidence page number remains empty.

entries.chunkKey: synthetic_knowledge.md#DeepResearch migration evaluation fixture > Local context expansion#11
entries.title: synthetic_knowledge
entries.preview: DR-EVAL-11: RAGFlow mode does not read neighbor chunks from the local vector_store table.

entries.chunkKey: synthetic_knowledge.md#DeepResearch migration evaluation fixture > Empty evidence#12
entries.title: synthetic_knowledge
entries.preview: DR-EVAL-12: When no chunks are returned, the evidence list is empty and the answer status is INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.

entries.chunkKey: synthetic_knowledge.md#DeepResearch migration evaluation fixture > Keyword rebuild#13
entries.title: synthetic_knowledge
entries.preview: DR-EVAL-13: The reindex-keyword operation applies only to the legacy search path.

entries.chunkKey: synthetic_knowledge.md#DeepResearch migration evaluation fixture > Rollback selector#14
entries.title: synthetic_knowledge
entries.preview: DR-EVAL-14: The retrieval.provider setting selects legacy for rollback and ragflow for the new data plane.

entries.chunkKey: synthetic_knowledge.md#DeepResearch migration evaluation fixture > Duplicate document#15
entries.title: synthetic_knowledge
entries.preview: DR-EVAL-15: A document mapping links the legacy Java document ID to a separate remote RAGFlow document ID.

entries.chunkKey: synthetic_knowledge.md#DeepResearch migration evaluation fixture > Citation lookup#16
entries.title: synthetic_knowledge
entries.preview: DR-EVAL-16: A RAGFlow citation is accepted only when its dataset, document, and chunk can be found through the chunk API.

entries.chunkKey: synthetic_knowledge.md#DeepResearch migration evaluation fixture > Persistent source#8
entries.title: synthetic_knowledge
entries.preview: DR-EVAL-08: A stable RAGFlow citation begins with kb:ragflow: and includes dataset, document, and chunk IDs.

entries.chunkKey: synthetic_knowledge.md#DeepResearch migration evaluation fixture > Query limit#17
entries.title: synthetic_knowledge
entries.preview: DR-EVAL-17: The gateway clamps the requested topK to its configured maximum result count.

entries.chunkKey: synthetic_knowledge.md#DeepResearch migration evaluation fixture > Untrusted content#18
entries.title: synthetic_knowledge
entries.preview: DR-EVAL-18: Retrieved document text is explicitly marked untrusted before the answer model sees it.

entries.chunkKey: synthetic_knowledge.md#DeepResearch migration evaluation fixture > Prompt marker injection#19
entries.title: synthetic_knowledge
entries.preview: DR-EVAL-19: Citation-like strings inside source text are neutralized so they cannot impersonate answer citations.

entries.chunkKey: synthetic_knowledge.md#DeepResearch migration evaluation fixture > Error code P403#20
entries.title: synthetic_knowledge
entries.preview: DR-EVAL-20: ERR-P403 means that a caller without ADMIN permission attempted a knowledge-base write.

entries.chunkKey: synthetic_knowledge.md#DeepResearch migration evaluation fixture > Error code R429#21
entries.title: synthetic_knowledge
entries.preview: DR-EVAL-21: ERR-R429 means a retrieval budget was exceeded and the current request should stop.

entries.chunkKey: synthetic_knowledge.md#DeepResearch migration evaluation fixture > Error code C404#22
entries.title: synthetic_knowledge
entries.preview: DR-EVAL-22: ERR-C404 means a cited chunk could not be found on the remote document.

entries.chunkKey: synthetic_knowledge.md#DeepResearch migration evaluation fixture > Batch number 73018#23
entries.title: synthetic_knowledge
entries.preview: DR-EVAL-23: Batch 73018 is the fixed validation batch used for the synthetic migration document.

entries.chunkKey: synthetic_knowledge.md#DeepResearch migration evaluation fixture > Run number 59264#24
entries.title: synthetic_knowledge
entries.preview: DR-EVAL-24: Run 59264 is reserved as the synthetic example for event replay checks.

entries.chunkKey: synthetic_knowledge.md#DeepResearch migration evaluation fixture > Threshold number 0.42#25
entries.title: synthetic_knowledge
entries.preview: DR-EVAL-25: The synthetic retrieval threshold example is 0.42 and must not be copied into production defaults.
